title: Resilience of rainbow Hamilton cycles in pseudorandom graphs
summary: We prove that every spanning subgraph $H$ of an $n$-vertex $(p,β)$-bijumbled graph, satisfying $δ(H)\geq(1/2+\varepsilon)pn$, where $\varepsilon > 0$ is arbitrarily small yet fixed, admits a rainbow Hamilton cycle under any globally $μpn$-bounded colouring, provided that $β\leq cpn$ and $pn\geq M$, where $μ$, $c$, and $M$ are positive constants depending solely on $\varepsilon$; in particular, $pn$ may be taken to be a sufficiently large constant.
